fields.description: Program Description The Chinese Language Program offered by the International Department aims to provide international students with a systematic and comprehensive Chinese learning experience, dedicated to cultivating international talents who understand and are friendly towards China. Based on solidifying listening, speaking, reading, and writing skills in Chinese, the curriculum organically integrates rich content on China's national conditions and culture. Our experienced teaching team will guide you in deeply exploring contemporary Chinese society, its developmental vitality, and historical context through language learning. By combining classroom teaching with social practice, you will gain the ability to use Chinese in real-life environments, understand China, enhance your language skills, and form a more comprehensive and profound understanding of the country.

fields.requirements: Entry Requirements This program is open to all international students with a need to learn Chinese. Whether you are a beginner or have some foundation in Chinese, you are welcome to join. Applicants should have an interest in Chinese culture, voluntarily abide by Chinese laws and regulations, and have no record of violations or crimes. Applicants must be in good health. Applicants must be at least 16 years old at the time of enrollment and hold a valid foreign ordinary passport.
